story: Highlands Hammock State Park covers 9,000 acres in Highlands County, Florida, west of Sebring. Opened in 1931, it features old-growth forest with an old-growth bald cypress swamp and trees believed to be over a thousand years old.
matters: Part of the natural area is recognized by the Old-Growth Forest Network. The park shelters wildlife including white-tailed deer, American alligators, and the rare Florida panther.
name: Highlands Hammock State Park
